candidate.answerReason: Each term n(1-1/n) equals n-1, so the expression is 1+2+...+9=45.

methods.label: Simplify each product
methods.explanation:
Each product has the same useful feature: multiplying the outside number by its reciprocal gives \(1\). For an integer \(n\) from \(2\) through \(10\), distributing gives
\[
n\left(1-\frac1n\right)
=n-\frac nn=n-1.
\]
Every such \(n\) is nonzero, so these divisions are defined. The expression therefore becomes \(1+2+\cdots+9\).

Pair the smallest number with the largest, leaving \(5\) in the middle:
\[
\begin{aligned}
1+2+\cdots+9
&=(1+9)+(2+8)\\
&\quad +(3+7)+(4+6)+5\\
&=4\times10+5=45.
\end{aligned}
\]
The value is \(45\), choice \(\mathrm{A}\).
methods.levelReason: Distributing, multiplying fractions by integers, and pairing small whole numbers are elementary AMC 8 techniques.
